_comment: The power modes, as a contract shared by Dart, Kotlin and Swift.
Only the cross-platform semantics are pinned here. The scan and advertise
constants are platform enums and have no common meaning; the numbers below
do. `estimatedDrainPercentPerHour` in particular is shown to the user in
Settings next to their choice, so if the Dart figure and the native duty
cycle drift apart the app is lying about what the setting costs.
These are engineering estimates until the Phase 6 battery measurement is
done on real hardware. See docs/FIELD-TEST.md for the protocol. When the
measured figures arrive, change this file first and then make all three
